name: Harbour Bean Roasters
ownersIntro:
Maya and Tom started roasting beans in their garage in 2014, selling bags to neighbours on weekends.
They designed every label by hand, and still do.
ownersCaption: From a garage roaster to the busiest corner of the Quay, every cup is still roasted in small batches.
